liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the run of Bird Song, Oh Babe It Ain't No Lie and Ripple as especially heartfelt [6]
- **Ripple** (1 review): There is no audience reaction when Ripple starts, suggesting few listeners knew the music; the crowd seems small [4]

## The recordings

- **gd80-12-06.cantor.clugston.5478.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 9 songs; 53 min; rated 4.41/5 by 49 [1]. Said about its sound: Despite having no PA, the audience recording sounds very good, with natural room ambience; Sound quality is fine given the circumstances, and it feels like being in the room; Recommended for headphones; described as an audience-style recording with Betty Cantor-Jackson's sound [3][6][7][8][11][13][14]
- **gd1980-12-06.151263.betty.master.flac16**: source not stated; 9 songs; 52 min; rated 2.71/5 by 7 [2]

## Around the show

- A woman introducing the band announced there was no PA system; the audience looked mostly like children in wheelchairs, per a photo [3]
- Jerry introduces the band during the show; reviewer saw a photo of the show in a book [7]
- Jerry over-enunciates lyrics as if singing to kids, at least early on; someone seems to ask what he is doing while tuning [8]
- The emcee thanks the clowns before introducing the band, and mispronounces Weir's name [10]
- Small, young audience; a kid tells Jerry he wants rock-n-roll, and Jerry responds [11]
- Acoustic set played at the Marin-Sonoma Muscular Dystrophy Association chapter's annual Christmas party, for children with muscular dystrophy [2]
- Reviewer calls this perhaps the best of the 1980 acoustic sets [11]
- Reviewer prefers the audience tape over any board source for this set, and likens its noise level to the Melkweg shows [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd80-12-06.cantor.clugston.5478.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Betty Cantor-Jackson; source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Betty Cantor-Jackson master audience cassette, transferred to DAT then CDR, extracted with EAC and shortened to SHN by Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1980-12-06.151263.betty.master.flac16**: taped by Recording by Betty Cantor-Jackson; transferred by All transfers and mastering by Jim Blackwood  Speed Correction by Jason Chastain; source: AKG C414 Stereo Pair > Sony D5 - Betty Cantor-Jackson's Master Cassette (UD-XL II 60) [2]. Also: Master tape circulated in the early 1990s via KXCI Tucson's Dead Air; updated version aired December 20, 2020 [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Michael Parrish: [Mill Valley Recreation Center, December 6, 1980: Grateful Dead (Beneficial Jerry)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2025/04/mill-valley-recreation-center-december.html) [16]
- Poster by Michael Parrish: [Mill Valley Recreation Center, December 6, 1980: Grateful Dead (Beneficial Jerry)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2025/04/mill-valley-recreation-center-december.html) [17]
